issue_request: FHIR-43441 asked OO to align ServiceRequest with the Workflow Request pattern for R6 by removing ServiceRequest.instantiatesCanonical and ServiceRequest.instantiatesUri, removing their instantiates-canonical and instantiates-uri search parameters, removing the corresponding Request.instantiates mappings, using Workflow instantiation extensions instead, and adding mappings from ServiceRequest.category to Request.category and ServiceRequest.orderDetail.parameterFocus[x] to Request.product.
initial_application: The Jira application comment identifies commit 696cf9c646. That commit deleted the two ServiceRequest instantiates elements from source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml, deleted the two ServiceRequest instantiates search parameters from source/servicerequest/bundle-ServiceRequest-search-params.xml, and added the requested workflow mappings. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-43441 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and the checked StructureDefinition/search-parameter bundle are authoritative build inputs. Later ServiceRequest work, including FHIR-54847 changes to parameterFocus[x], preserved the Request.product mapping. The FHIR Extension Pack contains the workflow replacement extension family and marks legacy workflow-instantiatesCanonical/workflow-instantiatesUri extensions as deprecated or retired. The only remaining ServiceRequest-local mentions of the removed elements are in source/servicerequest/servicerequest.svg, a generated-looking diagram artifact that the run guardrail says not to edit as the sole source-changing fix.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current authoritative ServiceRequest XML/search-parameter sources contain no instantiatesCanonical, instantiatesUri, instantiates-canonical, or instantiates-uri definitions, and source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml contains the requested Request.category and Request.product mappings.

related_jiras.note: Later ServiceRequest.parameterFocus[x] work changed the same element's wording and binding while retaining the Request.product workflow mapping, so it supports the no-change conclusion but was not separately decided.
